name: InvGate Service Management
summary: InvGate Service Management has a Starter plan at $1,499 a year for 5 agents, a Pro plan at $500 per agent a year with a $2,500 yearly minimum, and an Enterprise plan from $12,000 a year. All are billed annually. Starter and Pro offer a free trial of unstated length. InvGate says it holds ISO 27001:2022 certification and SOC 2 Type II audits.

facts.text: InvGate states it is certified under ISO 27001:2022 and refers to SOC 2 Type II audits.
The security page does not say where InvGate hosts its services and points to a separate trust center.
The pricing page says prices are base list prices that exclude taxes and fees and may change without notice.
The Starter plan has no workflow builder, which starts on Pro.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Fixed price. Unlimited end users and approvers, SSO and AI Hub, no workflow builder

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: From $2,500 a year for 5 to 100 agents. Adds a workflow builder, Microsoft Teams and WhatsApp

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom quote, starting at $12,000 a year. On-premise hosting and multiple SAML configurations

hiddenCosts: Listed prices exclude taxes and additional fees.
Enterprise has no free trial; the entry point is a quote request.

security.ssoPlan: Starter and above (SSO integration listed on Starter)
